notes.title: Voxel Update
notes.content:
In this update we showcase our new voxel deathmatch game mode!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42672893/e520327b13672a4d89593a88c6e21934b96fc282.png[/img]
To host a match, press the multiplayer button from the main menu, then host a match selecting Deathmatch. You can play on a voxel planet, or use the Rawbots universe by selecting the dimension.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42672893/cd0eb2c9fd8e9259c2e0abff01a097b531607209.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42672893/1f29ec75bb064b09756d9cceab02c74e2fc0c2cf.png[/img]
Controls:
 Move: WASD
 Aim: Right click
 Shoot: Left click

notes.title: Galaxy Update
notes.content:
Welcome to the latest update of the Rawbots universe! We are excited to show you our new galaxy view which help you explore planets with ease.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/5rN99R7.png[/img]
To access this view, simply warp out of the star system, or travel through the portal that can be located using [b]F2[/b]. In the galaxy view, you can pan by using right click and zoom using the scroll wheel. Click on a star to bring up the star system view where you can press on a planet to teleport nearby. To exit the star system you can zoom out using the scroll wheel which will return you back to the galaxy view.

notes.title: Procedural Update
notes.content: The time has come to release the first version of Rawbots containing procedural star systems! We have also introduced a new spaceship that will help you explore this procedural universe. The spaceship can be controlled with [b]WASD[/b] + [b]Mouse Cursor[/b], [b]Shift[/b] to boost and [b]V[/b] to warp. To access other star systems, press [b]F2[/b] to find the portal where you can then travel to it,

notes.title: Major Update 0.4.0
notes.content:
Release Notes
 
Features
 - Added 3D grid mode, you can toggle this mode by pressing Shift in build mode
 - Added Voltaic Arcs (found under the structural category)
 - Added propeller part

 Fixes

  - Fixed issues with physics in multiplayer
  - Fixed incorrect minutes on save time prompt
  - Fixed memory leak
